protocol.task: Control-assisted seen-target donor transfer; four nested outer donor folds
protocol.label: log1p(10000 * summed target counts / summed full-transcriptome UMI library) minus independent reference-control transform; not deposited DE logFC
protocol.state: Feature-control transform only; no perturbed state input
protocol.ridge: Train-only feature scaling; alpha 1/10/100 selected by equal inner-donor MSE; inverse donor-row-count training weights
protocol.selection_metric: All-readout inner donor MSE, including perturbed target; target-excluded scores are secondary, not independently tuned
protocol.aggregation: Summed target-guide pseudobulk counts, weighting more abundant cells/guides; not equal-guide mean
protocol.shuffle: Fixed training-donor derangement shared across conditions; test state remains correct
limits: Only four donors; seed or row variation is not donor confidence
Seen target-condition combinations only; no unseen target claim
Baseline provenance must establish separate control guide pools
All counts require measured complete panel; no missing groups zero-filled
Tiny ridge development comparison; no causal or machinery validation
